consumer_spec.accepted_roles: non-empty exact role set using canonical roles or x- extension roles
consumer_spec.allow_extension_roles: when true, any valid x- role may satisfy the role predicate
consumer_spec.require_fingerprint: when true, input provenance must carry a non-empty fingerprint
consumer_spec.minimum_revision: 0 disables revision gating; otherwise provenance revision must be >= this value

compatibility.incompatible: one or more declared predicates are proven false
compatibility.unknown: semantic input port is unbound, so compatibility cannot be proven

invariants: consumer compatibility never mutates AgentGraphBuilder or LayerRegistry
consumer requirements are caller-declared and are not inferred from layer type
unbound semantic metadata produces unknown rather than rejection
x- extension roles remain available and can be accepted exactly or by extension policy
non_goals: infer evaluator/state-updater/reward semantics from Linear, ReLU, Conv, or other numerical layer types
force low-level escape hatches to obey semantic policy

routing_projection.policy: caller-selected consumer semantics are projected onto canonical actions and exact graph steps without persistent binding

persistent_edge_binding.policy: an explicitly selected compatible consumer may be persisted on an exact graph step as immutable provenance without changing execution program identity
